items.job: Reseal or rebuild leaking roof hydraulic cylinders, refill and bleed
items.note: Rebuild kits cost about $50 to $100 per cylinder; new cylinders can cost $2,000 or more.

items.job: Replace Vario roof hydraulic pump, refill and bleed

items.t: Roof stops mid-cycle from a failed position switch
items.job: Diagnose and replace roof position microswitch
items.note: One owner paid about $20 for the switch and about $400 total at a dealer, mostly for diagnosis.

items.t: Engine stalls or won't restart when hot (crank sensor)

items.job: Replace ignition coils and spark plugs
items.note: About $400 to $600 for all coils and plugs on the V6; one coil costs much less.

items.t: No start from failed K40 relay module
items.job: Resolder or replace K40 relay module
items.note: Resoldering costs about $50; a replacement module about $200 to $400.

items.t: Harsh shifts or stuck in limp mode (5-speed automatic)
items.job: Replace transmission conductor plate and refill fluid
Replace balance shaft, timing chain and related parts
items.note: Owners on MBWorld report shop quotes of $4,000 or more.

items.t: Camshaft adjuster magnets leak oil or set codes
items.note: One owner paid $388 for two magnets at a shop; a dealer quoted $475 plus $125 for diagnosis.
